Byte 2 of the register bank PSW.RS selects

registers.title: Other Registers
rows: Second operand and result of MUL and DIV (direct byte $F0)
Carry flag PSW.7: the Boolean accumulator of the bit operations
Data pointer, DPH : DPL: addresses external RAM and code
A and B as the operand pair of MUL and DIV

registers.title: Special Function Registers (direct $80–$FF)
rows: Port 2, the high address byte of MOVX @Ri
The accumulator A as a direct byte (bit addressable)
B, the second operand of MUL and DIV (bit addressable)

registers.title: Program Status Word (PSW, $D0)
rows: Carry: out of bit 7, or borrow; the Boolean accumulator
Auxiliary carry: out of bit 3 (for DA)
Register bank select, low bit: R0-R7 at $00, $08, $10 or $18
Overflow: signed arithmetic, or MUL / DIV
Parity of A: set by hardware when A has an odd number of 1 bits

registers.title: Internal RAM
rows: R0-R7 of the bank PSW.RS selects
Bit addresses $00-$7F, bit b of byte $20 + n is bit 8n + b
Bit addresses $80-$FF are the bits of the SFRs at multiples of 8
